scope: 432 selected CPU regression tests, in focused/broad runs, and 50 selected physical Metal tests. Timing finished before broad CPU/Metal regression. qualification_only_followups.reason: Hosted ordinary optimized ABI tests require the excluded-from-all optimized task-core runtime target. Compiler/runtime and benchmark source/artifact bytes are unchanged.

The Windows ASan executables need their pinned compiler-rt DLL directory on PATH, as existing recursive/call-foundation suites already configure. Test cases and compiler/runtime/benchmark code remain unchanged; the helper is a no-op on macOS/Linux.
